ضَرْسٌ (assumed tropical:) Land of which the herbage is here and there (IAar, T, O, K, TA) and on which rain has fallen here and there: (IAar, T, TA:) and a portion of land upon which rain has fallen a day or part of a day. (TA.) ―
-b2- See also ضِرْسٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
